recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片有片狀壞死與核碎片，高倍下可見核增大、染色質呈毛玻璃狀（ground-glass）且邊緣化、甚至多核相互擠壓（molding）的病毒感染細胞；免疫染色 HSV 在壞死區周圍大量細胞呈強陽性，符合單純皰疹病毒淋巴結炎。
features: Lymph node with extensive necrosis, karyorrhectic debris and effacement of normal architecture
Enlarged cells with smudged, glassy (ground-glass) nuclei, chromatin margination and nuclear molding, including multinucleated forms
Background of fibrinoid necrosis with scattered inflammatory cells; neutrophil-poor
IHC for HSV: strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in numerous cells at the edge of necrosis
describe_en: Lymph node section shows areas of necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris replacing the normal architecture. At high power there are enlarged cells with glassy, smudged nuclei showing chromatin margination, nuclear molding and occasional multinucleation, consistent with herpesviral cytopathic effect. Immunohistochemistry for herpes simplex virus is strongly positive in numerous cells in and around the necrotic areas. Findings are consistent with herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis; this may coexist with an underlying lymphoma such as CLL/SLL and should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Kikuchi shows crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells around apoptotic debris without viral inclusions and is HSV negative.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin or anaplastic large cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Large atypical cells have prominent macronucleoli and are CD30 positive, rather than ground-glass nuclei with molding that stain for HSV.
CMV cells show large eosinophilic 'owl-eye' intranuclear inclusions with halos plus cytoplasmic granules and are CMV IHC positive.
Lupus lymphadenitis shows hematoxylin bodies and vasculitis without viral cytopathic changes.
